notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Update Notes[/b]

- Bug improvements.
- Leaderboard is now available for active use.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
- Visual and layout enhancements have been implemented in the in-game user interface.
- Several adjustments have been added to improve menu navigation and user experience.
- Resolved crashes occurring in a specific section due to a bug encountered by players.
- Revisions have been made to game balance and features based on feedback from the gaming community.
